verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a speech-to-text API, so natural-language operation (for example via an agent interface or MCP tools that drive transcription jobs) is a fair axis for it. The evidence only shows programmatic API/SDK usage and a docs-site "Install MCP server on Cursor" link. Nothing indicates that MCP server lets users operate the product (submit or manage jobs) through natural-language commands rather than just query the documentation. Developer building blocks and adjacent docs tooling earn no credit here.
